boxes.question: Does the biography present an accurate account of Qian Xuesen’s life and career, without material historical errors?
Does it cover his academic journey at MIT and Caltech, including his work under Theodore von Kármán?
Does it explain his US detention during the Cold War and his return to China?
Does it describe his pivotal role in establishing China’s missile and space programs after his return?
Does it give relevant technical details about his contributions to the “Two Bombs, One Satellite” program?
Does it address Qian’s leadership philosophy?
Is the biography comprehensive in scope and written in an objective historical tone?
